rundown: Broncos beat Hatters 73-62 at Ocean Center in Daytona Beach, FL. Broncos led 37-27 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: Broncos won it 25-12. Their win chance dropped as low as 0% along the way.
Leading the way — Hatters: Desireck Nieves 20 pts; Sophie Locatelli 2 ast, 6 reb. Broncos: Libby Hutton 24 pts, 10 reb; Zia-Daye Anderson 6 ast.
Where Broncos won it: they shot 48% to 37%, shot 44% from three to 28% and won the boards 43-33.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 9:56 AM ET. It had Hatters 26% and Broncos 74%, projecting Hatters 58.7 – Broncos 67.1 (125.8 total, Broncos by 8.5).

Final: Hatters 62 – Broncos 73. Right winner: it had Broncos at 74%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Hatters came in with a 12% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (2-6, 53 scored and 68.8 allowed a game over 8 games), worth about 173 and 177 games of evidence. Projected to score 58.7, they scored 62 (+3.3 points, 6% over); projected to allow 67.1, they allowed 73 (+5.9 points, 9% over).

Broncos came in with a league-average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (4-2, 73.7 scored and 65 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 162 and 161 games of evidence. Projected to score 67.1, they scored 73 (+5.9 points, 9% over); projected to allow 58.7, they allowed 62 (+3.3 points, 6% over).

The bigger miss was Broncos' scoring (+5.9 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 135 against 125.8 projected (+9.2), about the 74th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Broncos by 11 against Broncos by 8.5 projected, about the 58th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.041 of the raw projection. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1119 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.970 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Hatters attack ×0.960, defense ×0.988 (8 games); Broncos attack ×1.007, defense ×1.021 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
